suppressions.reason: Lynis does not detect the active Debian deb822 security sources on these hosts.
suppressions.evidence: Fresh 2026-10-11 inspections confirmed the trixie-security suite in nginx /etc/apt/sources.list.d/*.sources and coolify/runtime-control /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources. A fresh 2026-10-13 runtime-comms inspection also confirmed trixie-security in /etc/apt/sources.list.d/*.sources; this finding checks only legacy sources.list formats.
suppressions.recheck_when: Revalidate if the Debian source format or Lynis package-source detection changes.

suppressions.reason: The host is managed with nftables, not legacy iptables rules.
suppressions.evidence: Fresh 2026-10-11 inspections confirmed active inet filter input and forward chains with drop policies and rules on nginx and Coolify. A fresh 2026-10-13 runtime-comms inspection confirmed nftables input and forward chains both have drop policies and a non-empty ruleset; its empty legacy iptables rules are expected.
suppressions.recheck_when: Revalidate if the guest firewall backend or nftables policy changes.
